design_description: A provocative “Mo Money Mummy” concept built around a full-body money-and-bandage mummy pattern. Repeated US $100 bills sit underneath overlapping off-white fabric strips, creating the illusion that the entire jersey is wrapped like a mummy with money trapped between the layers. The palette is deliberately muted — aged cream, beige and desaturated dollar green — giving the artwork a slightly vintage, dirty-money aesthetic rather than making it overly colourful. The white crew collar and cuffs provide a simple neutral finish. At the centre, “MO MONEY MUMMY” appears in a large horror-inspired dripping typeface, using acid green with a heavy black treatment to create the strongest focal point and inject a playful Halloween/streetwear character. The Momuto branding is kept small and black so it disappears naturally into the artwork, while the small “ALL HUSTLE / NO CURSE” hem tag reinforces the money/mummy concept without overcrowding the composition. Overall, it is a high-impact novelty football design combining money, mummy wrapping and horror graphics, with the all-over illustrated pattern doing most of the visual work.
